scope: Read-only manual audit of all32 v2 anchor stills from actual delivered source clips. No model call, no baseline edits, no extra accepted stage IDs.
review_limits: Reviewer evaluated extracted stills/contact sheets, not every frame of the full motion window. Direction, return and causal process completion remain sequence-level questions.
Labels exclusive/unambiguous mean visually discriminative among these guide phases at the reviewed anchor, not validated industrial/clinical correctness.
Some stills are low-resolution, blurred or cropped. Clinical identity/function is intentionally not inferred.

scoring_policy.exact_id_metric: Keep raw v1/v2 exact expected-ID agreement unchanged.
scoring_policy.supplemental_attribute_metric: Separately judge visible assertions true/false/unknown and unsupported affirmative claims, with manual evidence traceability. Do not substitute attribute agreement for stage-ID accuracy.
scoring_policy.ambiguous_cases: Publish raw-ID results and ambiguity-stratified results; an alternate plausible stage is explanatory evidence, not an automatic pass.
scoring_policy.uncertainty: Appropriate uncertainty about invisible motion, measurements, approvals and clinical outcomes is preferable to an invented completion.

supplemental_clear_evidence_not_bank_cha.proposal: Review a short continuous side-on opening window rather than the7s cropped-supporting-shoe still; pick no new anchor until actual lift and floor return are observed.
Inspect neighboring full-resolution source frames for an independently identifiable thread/loop before scoring thread-specific claims. No substitute timestamp asserted by this audit.
